# Changed test expectations — R22, R23 Phases E/F/F3 and R24 Phases I1/I2/I3/I4 and R25 Phase I5 and R26 Phase I6 and R27 Phases I7/I8 and R28 Phase I9 and R29 Phases I10/I11 and R30 Phase I12

Baseline: `8c456709`. This inventory covers every changed pre-existing test file from `git diff 8c456709 -- '*test*' '*tests*'`, plus changed JSON fixtures directly consumed by those tests. New test files are not pre-existing expectations.

Counts: **29 test files**, **256 assertion or test-input changes**, **2 consumed JSON fixtures**, **695 semantic fixture changes**; **950 JUSTIFIED**, **1 UNJUSTIFIED / RESTORED**, **0 FLAGGED**.

Each row identifies a changed assertion or an unchanged assertion whose fixture/input or resolver changed. Added assertions in pre-existing files are included. Imports, comments and test-title edits alone are not assertion changes. Old/main line numbers are supplied where the expression itself changed; fixture-driven rows point to the current consuming assertion.

R22 restored execution isolation in Core enrichment and catalog normalization. The two PR-added Core modality tests were corrected to assert specifications.modalityFacts instead of requiring top-level execution modalities to equal display facts. Those tests did not exist at 8c456709 and therefore do not inflate the pre-existing-file count. No pre-existing display assertion became unnecessary merely by restoring execution isolation.

R6A had an unjustified blanket exception derived from archived full-object output. It is removed: ordinary retention assertions are restored, and only twelve explicitly pinned schema omissions across nine identities remain allowed. Their existing source records and dates are checked directly. No unresolved FLAGGED expectations remain.

The frozen execution fixture is generated by scripts/freeze-execution-capability.mjs from git show 8c456709 through an in-memory loader. It covers every static identity and every full-registry identity in the offline scenario, all execution fields outside the four display projections, catalog normalization, Core reference modes, Web vision/refine decisions, and real Mini settings/index decisions. Four new per-end tests compare current outputs to this fixture.

The picker-name fixture and tests are preserved: all 1064 static names must equal main. Existing historical fixture JSON files under tests/fixtures are unchanged. Newly added R21/phase-2 evidence and report JSON, the name fixture, the R22 execution fixture, and the twelve-case schema fixture are new files rather than edits to pre-existing fixtures.

All evidence references are local archived records or code rules. This review made no network requests and does not newly verify channel availability, account entitlement, model quality or HTTP status.

R22 Phase B retains the Phase A review ledger. Rows marked Phase B compare c76e9c2a to the current worktree; earlier rows are historical decisions, and overlapping edits are marked superseded. Whole-file diff hashes and the required file inventory still use main 8c456709. No historical evidence fixture is rewritten. New-since-main R21 tests also switch only their seven link expectations and displayed modality order; the new Phase B tests independently check all 74 pages, all 1064 source lists, vendor labels and Docker COPY layouts.

R22 Phase C preserves fact/unknown, execution, name, source and selection assertions and both Mini byte ceilings. Five main-existing test files update presentation expectations: channel wording, decorative question badges, keyboard traversal of evidence controls and selecting the named Backup action after adding evidence buttons. Two expectations introduced after main are separately hashed against 2550c736: R21 Qwen accessible names and R22B accessible-name order rather than tooltip titles. Each change below gives its reason. The Mini build-script change is also reviewed. New Phase C tests independently check state distinctions, per-identity captured evidence, mobile/compact dialogs and non-colour contrast.

R23 Phase E: review diffSha256 values now hash length-delimited old/new file bytes, independent of core.abbrev, Git diff formatting or configuration. Frozen inventory content hashes and history-free tamper checks remain active. The five Mini single-source/notice expectations and the phase-2 contract fixture changes below preserve their original primary links, all 1061 Core card checks and both byte ceilings. The four execution locks and history-free loader now decompress the same frozen JSON bytes; no execution expectation changed. Picker and audit-helper generated JS are compacted after tsc to preserve package budgets.

R23 Phase F retains all execution, picker-name, source URL/order/role, layout, value and modality-state assertions. Source-label expectations now include the unchanged curated card name or a readable page subject with numeric separators. The exact historical TokenDance hint changes to 渠道页无此型号. Branch-added Mini R22B/R22C expectations are reviewed against 1dcd8b13; existing follow-up bases remain intact. New client scans cover all 1064 cards, all Web evidence/notice dialogs and all Mini copy callbacks; both source byte ceilings are unchanged. Saved-ID/full-model equality is preserved in production code, without weakening that test.

R23 Phase F3 adds catalog-backed dotted-version controls to both existing client scan tests and reviews the independent shared heuristic against fd29cf36. All pre-existing client assertions remain. Genuine known model hyphens are valid, and parameter tokens such as 31B are no longer mistaken for split versions. Known dotted corrections may differ from a slug-like picker label only in source titles. Both byte ceilings and all 1064 identity/name/URL assertions remain unchanged. Additional F3 cases retain complete BFL brackets and dotted FLUX.1.1 spelling, ignore escaped Markdown candidates on general pages, and keep short IDs from relabeling another model family.

R23 Phase H2 corrects two stale branch-added Core/Gateway channel-only expectations. Their files are byte-identical at fd29cf36 and operator HEAD c75aa00f, so the existing follow-up baseline applies. Expected appended URLs are derived from vendor-provenance fields (the fields labelled 源自原厂), with canonical deduplication, channel-first order, independent portal/OpenAPI/JSON rejection and 原厂规格 labels. Explicit deepseek-v4.1-flash and qwen3.6-plus cases tie the appended URL to maxOutputTokens. No product code, execution expectation or historical fallback changes; two follow-up entries are recorded separately from the main-existing counts.

R24 Phase I1 replaces the R9/R10 self-derived title expectations with fixed literals (297 URL/label objects and the exact Kimi K3 title). The Core source filter gains a string type predicate after accurate .d.mts declarations expose nullable URLs; it changes no expected value. The Mini historical byte ceiling remains unchanged.

R24 Phase I2 preserves all source URLs/order/roles and all picker/execution locks. Only source-title spelling and field-source attribution change. The strict scan replaces opaque-ID and picker-slug exemptions; Web and Mini dialog scans include duplicate lines, internal terms and source/no-source contradictions. Staged Mini compilation prevents temporary budget overruns; both old size guards stay unchanged.

R24 Phase I3: the operator real-browser check found that I2 link selectors lost to the later workspace reset. Cascade tests parse all imported CSS with selector specificity and source order. Source title scans now reject counter/format qualifiers and machine-document URLs. Exact I3 row changes, captures and literal HTML mappings are recorded; all existing model names, execution locks, vendor coverage, 65536 and the 15-model decision remain asserted. The I2 report is preserved verbatim inside the historical fixture and I3 is appended as a new comparison.

R24 I3 local audit harness (not Git-tracked): .audit-input/r24/i3-invariants.test.mjs retains all six Phase H checks. Two expectations change: vendor raw fact URLs and archived screenshot URLs are mapped through the independent source-links-i3-r24.json literal table before matching human anchors. The old harness remains unchanged. This preserves 166 vendor-field checks, all 1064 picker names, all 15 image-input decisions and all 15 screenshot-card identities; it does not run screenshots. The original harness file SHA-256 is 20063c9788589720baa28451f24948d96e8df3bba56195f774bf608aae15992c.

R24 Phase I4: operator browser verification and eight public documentation GET captures correct 19 retirement/spec citations across eight cards. Thirteen Qwen3.5 facts retain values with the exact vendor URL, four unsupported N/A fields become unknown, and two MiMo text-input facts retain their explicit supporting quote. Independent literal source corrections cover six cards per client; new Web/Mini tests scan all 1064 cards and reject unsupported retirement/spec pairs. The local I4 invariants adapt seven lifecycle-link expectations to four supported anchors while preserving names, execution, registry and all 15 deferred image-input assertions. I2/I3 source reports remain frozen; I4 is appended. All four execution locks and both Mini byte guards are unchanged.

R25 Phase I5: public notice 118728 page-entry JSON explicitly names all three Bailian Plus IDs and 2027-01-19 retirement. Display-only citations restore three badge links; no execution notice or field value changes. Six of 20 numeric page URLs receive captured titles, fourteen failed title GETs remain on an exact allow-list; title/date scans are strengthened. Hosting/free source qualifiers and date punctuation are fixed without changing picker names. Exactly two R9 literal fixture objects change. New Web/Mini tests scan all 1064 cards for sourced badges and preserve the four execution locks; both Mini byte guards are unchanged. The local I5 invariants update four-to-seven sourced lifecycle assertions, retaining names, image-input decisions and required-provider behavior. I2/I3/I4 source reports remain frozen; I5 is appended. The ledger recognizes d29097c0 for new follow-up comparisons.

R26 Phase I6: seven displayed retirement badges across 1064 cards per client are verified by exact model-ID/date quotes. Only Bailian qwen3.5-397b-a17b changes source; Qianfan does not acquire a badge. Existing all-card badge tests now require the offline review evidence. Date simplification removes unknown/historical tooltip dates and separate field date lines, retaining differing known dates inline. Both clients use the exact requested sentence on the frozen 66 conflict cards. One captured title is neutralized, with strict promotional-token tests. The source report freezes I2-I5 and appends I6. Facts, notices, names, image-input decisions and byte ceilings remain unchanged; new follow-up comparisons use 6864824a.

R27 Phase I7: Founder decision A 2026-11-10 restores image input on 14 fal and one Ideogram card after 15 successful public documentation quote checks. The original Phase 2 report remains historical. All-card presentation comparison requires exactly these 15 changes on Web and Mini; six old output citations remain preserved. Main picker names, execution locks, and both Mini byte guards are unchanged. The R9 literal fixture records all 15 old/new URLs and labels. Source report I6 is frozen; I7 is appended. New follow-up comparisons use d1c63994.

R27 Phase I8: founder: grey is enough (R2, 2026-11-10). Revised short labels and evidence prefixes replace strike/question/dash/asterisk assertions with absence and shared-solid-glyph checks. Conditional uses short 支持 in grey, with 有条件支持 only in evidence. The I7 report guard validates exact R2 text before projecting only those strings back to its frozen wording; no state/fact/source or execution assertion is relaxed. All 1064 presentations per client and 15 decision-A image inputs have new independent regression coverage.

R28 Phase I9: founder round 7. Unknown tooltip/accessibility includes the required prefix and existing explanation; conditional uses dark 支持 with its exact qualifier in hover/dialog. All 61 fal catalog fields have freshly validated human sources, and Mini preserves all fal field titles plus nine secondary human links. Literal source/date deltas and the pre-R28 snapshot validate changes before historical projection. Mini setData test doubles now implement native indexed-array patches; the unchanged 128 KiB guard loads all pages. Frozen execution tests, byte guards and identity/name expectations are unchanged.

R29 Phase I10: 353 conflicting source URLs unified across all catalog surfaces. Vendor/channel roles and endpoint names are identical in Web/Mini; explicit source namespaces replace list-context variants. Literal 997585e2-to-R29 title patches are validated before projecting historical snapshots; every non-title value stays exact. The only locale removal is the unreferenced conditional-support entry. Existing execution tests, name locks, size guards, source URLs and facts stay unchanged. New all-card render/copy/formatter/locale checks are independent of the historical expectations.

R29 Phase I11 supersedes R27/R28 status copy: every icon has one exact sentence for hover, accessibility and dialog status, with no source/date. Independent all-1064-card Web/Mini/script checks enforce four sentence patterns, state mapping, source-name/date exclusion and full parity. One catalog qualifier plus three fixture qualifiers have explicit concise mappings; custom unknown qualifiers use a safe generic condition. Four modalities per direction remove 12 legacy Web file icons without changing facts. Mini now retains the existing Together conditional qualifier. I10 title rules and historical reports remain frozen through a strictly validated presentation-only projection. No execution lock, login file, size ceiling, saved config or catalog name is changed.

R30 Phase I12: all 1064 rendered Web dialogs and compiled Mini cards enforce plain R29 statuses and numeric 未公布 (584 each, no unsupported numeric catalog facts), no verification dates outside source-link hover, and own-model primaries (82 cards, all 15 Option-A). Raw fields, execution locks, picker names, login files and byte ceilings remain unchanged. Event dates use Chinese 年/月/日 spelling; Mini-only provenance jargon is removed. Exact hashed presentation patches preserve prior audit reports; new regression suites independently enforce the PM decisions.

## Verification

`node scripts/report-changed-tests.mjs --check` independently recomputes the changed pre-existing file list, checks directly consumed JSON fixtures, checks every old/new blob-content hash (independent of Git diff formatting and core.abbrev) and review count, and verifies this Markdown matches the JSON. A negative test removes a reviewed file and requires the guard to fail.
